//ignoreCommand: Exit 0 = skip build, non-zero = build. Production ALWAYS builds (exit 1) — a skipped prod deploy is far more costly than a wasted build. Previews skip only when the last commit touched nothing inside the Root Directory (Front-end/web). Caveat: this compares HEAD^..HEAD, so a multi-commit push whose LAST commit is backend-only will skip; that is acceptable for previews, never for prod.
ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then exit 1; else git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- .; fi
